facts.fact: Dhanu gives Kunal two red-thread walnuts as runner tokens: a boy bearing one is Dhanu's word, and Dhanu comes without asking why until after. Kunal had also carried a third plain walnut for Mini, which he ties with Gauri's red thread.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires the walnut rule and the walnuts for Kunal, and the private-face scene requires a walnut for Mini.

facts.fact: Mini, six, once asked Kunal for a walnut with a string like the runners', and he said 'when I'm back'.
facts.why: needed because it motivates the private-face walnut scene.

facts.fact: Kunal's dead right fingertips cannot pinch thread, so he ties knots with his teeth and the heel of his hand.
facts.why: needed because it follows from the ch 21 injury and makes the knot-tying scene specific.
